_meta.author: max
_meta.note: VA federal candidacy currency. All 27 VA U.S. House records carrying a passed next_election_date of 2026-08-04 were checked against the OFFICIAL certified results of Virginia's August 4, 2026 primary (delayed from June by the General Assembly). 23 resolved here: 19 lost their primary -> lost_primary with the date cleared (they are not on the November ballot); 4 won -> general_candidate rolled to 2026-11-03. Source for every record is the Virginia Department of Elections ENR feed, 100% of units reporting, as of 2026-08-18. Each record's EXISTING profile.confidence is passed through explicitly, because refine-records.py stamps evidence_<tier> on any profile written without one - the mislabel bug fixed earlier tonight. No score or rubric cell is touched. 4 records are NOT included because no primary was held in their district in either party, so this source cannot settle them: edwin-rivera (VA-03), beth-macy (VA-06), arthur-purves (VA-11), tony-sabio (VA-08, absent from the certified VA-08 Democratic field).
